name: ApeCoin (APE)
fix_description: In claimTokens, add require(msg.sender == tx.origin) to prevent contract callers (including flash loan callbacks) from claiming. Alternatively, record each address's last interaction block and require block.number > lastInteractionBlock[msg.sender] before allowing a claim, ensuring the caller held the NFT for at least one block. The exploit uses a flash loan to temporarily hold BAYC NFTs within a single transaction, calls claimTokens to collect APE for those never-claimed tokenIds, then returns the NFTs — all atomically in one tx.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit: flash-loan NFTX vault tokens, redeem BAYC NFTs, claim the ApeCoin airdrop, then remint/repay. It relies on an obvious airdrop-claim eligibility oversight around temporary NFT ownership and requires only a few protocol interactions with minimal complex DeFi reasoning.
